response.sql: SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS project_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry)) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) * 1.0 / AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) * 1.0) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM scanqc q JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = q.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux

assumptions.assumption: Only NULL fundflux values are treated as 'missing', and they form one group (GROUP BY puts NULLs together). Empty-string or placeholder values are treated as ordinary funding sources.

The total across funding sources is the sum of the per-group distinct project counts. Each project has exactly one funding source, so this equals the number of distinct projects with QC records. The average per funding source is the mean of those counts over the funding-source groups that appear, including the NULL group. Funding sources with no QC-linked projects are not in the average.
The fraction and ratio are returned as unrounded decimals (the *1.0 avoids integer division).
